operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table/column names (School, School_id, IHSAA_Class, total_budget_percent_budgeted) — must be double-quoted; case-insensitive lookup needed.
Tiny DB (8/8/11 rows) — no huge-table sampling concern; original_values fully read.
School.School_id is TEXT ('1','2',...) but budget.School_id and endowment.School_id are INT — FK parent/child declared types disagree; storage both integer-ish.
budget has composite PK (School_id, Year); School_id is also an FK to School — composite-PK member that is also FK child.
budget.School_id distinct=5 but School has 8 rows — FK child values are a strict subset of parent PKs (not all parents referenced).
endowment.School_id distinct=8 = School rows, but endowment has 11 rows — FK child has duplicates (many-to-one).
Budget_invested_percent declared TEXT but stores numeric-looking strings ('42.9','159.3') — storage class text, semantics numeric.
total_budget_percent_budgeted / _invested declared REAL, values like 2.0/2.4 — small real range, distinct=3.
County values contain embedded digits and spaces ('50 Marshall','46 LaPorte 71 St. Joseph') — free text, not a clean enum.
donator_name holds place names with accents ('San José de Ocoa','San Cristóbal') — non-ASCII text.
IHSAA_Class distinct=3 (A/AA/AAA), IHSAA_Football_Class distinct=4 (adds AAAA) — small enums, overlapping but not equal.
No NOT NULL, no CHECK, no UNIQUE beyond PKs; all columns nullable in DDL.
operator_ts_expectations: School.School_id (TEXT, PK) -> String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings, not '1'..'8' — breaks joins to budget/endowment unless FK fill copies parent values.
budget.School_id (INT, FK) -> filled from School.School_id final values (strings) with replacement; type mismatch tolerated by sqlite affinity.
budget composite PK (School_id,Year): sample_fresh_primary_keys drops dup tuples; Year Number fuzzer draws ~uniform in [-10^4,10^4] so many distinct years, few collisions.
endowment_id (INT PK) Number fuzzer: random ints in [-10^4,10^4] with +-1/+-2 perturbation — plausible-looking but unrelated to 1..11.
Enrollment/Budgeted/Invested (INT) Number fuzzer: uniform in [-10^4,10^4] — negative enrollments/budgets implausible (FN source for range predicates).
total_budget_percent_* (REAL) Number scale=4: uniform in [-10^4,10^4] — implausible ratios (FN for 'between 1 and 3' style).
Budget_invested_percent (TEXT) String fuzzer: random strings, not numeric — breaks numeric comparisons/casts (FN).
IHSAA_Class / IHSAA_Football_Class String fuzzer: random strings, not A/AA/AAA — breaks equality/IN predicates (FN).
County / donator_name / School_name / Mascot String fuzzer: random strings + contamination — no ties/duplicates, so GROUP BY / DISTINCT / self-join tie queries get FP.
School_id TEXT vs INT across tables: joins still work via affinity but literal-pool seeding may attach '1' to both — mixed.
Small tables (8/8/11) with size ~30-200: TS inflates row counts, so COUNT/aggregate gold answers rarely match (FP on count predicates).
No UNIQUE columns besides PKs, so drop_unique_duplicates is a no-op; duplicates only arise via PK collisions.
